weekly.input: Evidence-validated Daily Research publications and Analysis Results for 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-16; current main-branch Scheduler/Worker Control and Weekly Prompt; the P2 Registry and P2 Special Study contract; editorial and evidence policies; and current primary GitHub evidence for all due P2 objects.
weekly.input_zh: 2026-08-10 至 2026-08-16 已通过证据验证的 Daily Research Publication 与 Analysis Result、当前 main 分支 Scheduler / Worker Control / Weekly Prompt、P2 Registry 与 P2 Special Study Contract、编辑与证据政策，以及全部到期 P2 对象的当前 GitHub 一手证据。
weekly.workResult: Synthesized seven fully published Daily Runtime days comprising 21 eligible research notes into a new cross-column Weekly judgment rather than concatenating Daily articles. The recurring control failure is a handoff boundary where continuity, identity, authorization, execution, materialization and external-effect settlement are incorrectly promoted into one another. The synthesis introduces an Evidence-Bearing Handoff Contract spanning occurrence/work identity, intent and eligibility, authority decision, ownership epoch, materialization/execution, effect evidence, semantic terminal result and custody/reconciliation. The P2 lane resolved all six due objects as first-run governed baselines; no prior P2 checkpoint existed, no supported change delta was manufactured, no trigger score reached the threshold, and no full Special Study was selected.
weekly.workResult_zh: 将连续七个已完成公开发布的 Daily Runtime 日、共 21 篇合格研究综合为新的跨栏目 Weekly 判断，而不是拼接 Daily 文章。反复出现的控制失败集中在交接边界：连续性、身份、授权、执行、实例化与外部副作用收口被错误地相互升级。本次提出 Evidence-Bearing Handoff Contract（带证据的交接合同），覆盖发生实例/工作身份、意图与资格、权限决定、Ownership Epoch、实例化/实际执行、Effect Evidence、Semantic Terminal Result 与 Custody/Reconciliation。P2 通道完成全部 6 个到期对象的首次受治理基线；由于此前不存在 P2 检查点，本次没有人为制造变化增量，没有任何 Trigger Score 达到阈值，也未选择完整专项研究。
weekly.output: Weekly 005 — Every Handoff Needs a Receipt, published as independent English and Chinese Weekly Research pages with an editorial cover; plus a contract-valid 2026-08-16 P2 baseline run for all six registered P2 objects.
weekly.output_zh: 发布 Weekly 005《每一次交接都需要回执》的中英文独立 Weekly Research 页面与编辑题图，并形成符合合同的 2026-08-16 P2 基线运行记录，覆盖全部 6 个已登记 P2 对象。
weekly.next: Next week, test one consequential handoff end to end, test recovery under ownership replacement with a stale-owner late result, and test cancellation while an external effect remains uncertain. For P2, use this run as the comparison baseline; biweekly-or-release objects receive release/material-commit checks on the next Weekly run and full reviews when their 14-day cadence becomes due, while monthly objects remain governed by their monthly cadence.
weekly.next_zh: 下一周优先完成三项验证：端到端建模一次高后果交接；在 Ownership Replacement 后注入旧 Owner Late Result 验证恢复与 Fencing；在外部 Effect 仍不确定时测试 Cancellation。P2 方面，以本次运行作为比较基线；biweekly-or-release 对象在下一次 Weekly 执行版本/实质提交检查，并在 14 天完整复查周期到期时复查；monthly 对象继续按月度节奏治理。
